title: Detailed bluestem photos: Texas KR collar, scaled Austrian spikelets, little bluestem pair

photos.name: kr-collar
photos.label: KR bluestem — Texas collar-area hairs
photos.creator: Matt Lavin
photos.caption: PROVISIONAL — USER PHOTO REVIEW PENDING. Texas source photograph shows long hairs beside two blade/sheath junctions. Use it to locate the collar area. The small ligule membrane is not isolated clearly enough here to measure or label its exact edge; no ruler is present.
photos.role: Texas collar-area hair close-up; true ligule measurement remains missing
photos.limit: Texas source outside Hays County; source-labelled B. ischaemum, not independently vouchered Texas variety.

photos.name: kr-spikelets
photos.label: B. ischaemum — scaled spikelets, Austrian reference
photos.creator: Stefan.lefnaer
photos.caption: PROVISIONAL — USER PHOTO REVIEW PENDING. Three detached awned spikelets show bent, twisted awns beside the photographer's 3 mm scale bar. This is an Austrian species-level reference, not a Texas KR voucher. The companion spikelets are not retained as intact attached pairs, so it does not close the local paired-spikelet gap.
photos.role: Scaled detached awned spikelets — non-Texas species-level anatomy reference
photos.limit: Austria; not proof of local songarica morphology or intact sessile/pedicelled pair.

photos.name: little-spikelets
photos.label: Little bluestem — spikelet pair close-up
photos.creator: Matt Lavin
photos.caption: PROVISIONAL — USER PHOTO REVIEW PENDING. Close-up shows a larger awned spikelet beside a slender hairy stalk and reduced companion spikelet. The photographer identifies the stalked companion as a small narrow scale. This improves the pair-anatomy lesson; there is no ruler, rooted plant or collar in this frame.
photos.role: Sessile spikelet and reduced stalked companion close-up, source under historical Andropogon name
photos.limit: Source locality not established here; not a Hays voucher or scaled measurement.
